answer: Reputation carry-over bonds. Each identity starts at a fixed credit inlet, and reputation only transfers along a verified history chain, so a clone starts at zero regardless of how many the attacker spawns. Crossing into trusted tiers costs a walnut-sized fee plus a cooldown per identity, paid in compute and time. An attacker cloning N identities pays N fees and N cooldowns, while an honest agent pays once. The oasis of trusted tier is thus cheaper to reach honestly than to forge.
